news.title: Ikoma Technologies Limited Announces Resignation of Independent Director Chahan Vinod Vora, Effective January 2, 2026
news.body: Ikoma Technologies Limited announced that Mr. Chahan Vinod Vora (DIN: 10275707) has resigned from the position of Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 2, 2026, due to increasing professional commitments. Mr. Vora also resigned from all associated Committees of Ikoma Technologies Limited (formerly known as Vuenow Technologies Limited). Mr. Vora was the Chairperson of the Audit Committee and a member of the Nomination & Remuneration Committee and Stakeholders Relationship Committee in Marinetrans India Limited. The resignation was communicated in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and the company's internal policies.
